public JsonMetaSchema getMetaSchema(String iri, SchemaValidatorsConfig config) {
    String key = normalizeMetaSchemaUri(iri);
    JsonMetaSchema result = metaSchemas.computeIfAbsent(key, id -> loadMetaSchema(id, config));
    return result;
}

Branches: computeIfAbsent may call loadMetaSchema if absent; also key normalization may affect. Need tests for when metaSchemas already contains key (no load), and when not (load called). Also test null iri? normalizeMetaSchemaUri may handle null? Not shown but static method likely returns something or throws. We can test behavior with null and expect NullPointerException. Also test with different iri variations leading to same normalized key (e.g., with trailing slash). Also test that config is passed to loadMetaSchema.

We'll produce test cases grouped by scenario: existing schema, new schema, null iri, normalized key equivalence.

Test case 2: key already present in map, computeIfAbsent returns existing without calling loadMetaSchema.
